data.define: Describes jokes that are so silly they're embarrassing.

misuse.text: Don't call your teacher's joke 'corny' out loud.

data.l1_hook: Le jeu de mots de papa encore. Sérieusement ? "corny".
data.l1_ex: Les blagues de papa sont tellement "corny".

native.tip: “corny” = cliché. Exemple: “Dad's jokes are so corny.”
